- Count odd elements in lst1 and count even elements in lst2; since exchanges can swap any number of elements, lst1 can be made all even iff every odd in lst1 can be replaced by an even from lst2.
- Therefore, compute num_odds_in_lst1 and num_evens_in_lst2; if num_evens_in_lst2 >= num_odds_in_lst1 return "YES", else "NO".
- Edge checks: lists are non-empty per spec; treat numbers as integers; parity determined by n % 2.
